summary: The change updates the DECISIONS.md follow-up section and the pass module header to match the implemented behavior: one issue per unresolved P1/P2/P3 finding, v2 per-finding markers with legacy v1 suppression, and no per-pass create-count cap; the remaining documented limits match the code constants.

evidence: docs/DECISIONS.md:2478-2482 now states one issue per unresolved P1/P2/P3 finding and that the 2026-10-31 owner directive supersedes the original combined-issue behavior.

docs/DECISIONS.md:2493-2501 and 2509-2516 now describe the v2 finding marker, legacy v1 combined-marker coverage, and no per-pass create-count cap with the remaining merge-check, candidate, listing, budget and size limits.
ops/hosted-autonomy-follow-up-pass.ts:1-17 now documents one issue per finding, v2/v1 duplicate semantics, and no per-pass create-count cap.

Implementation corroboration: `ops/hosted-autonomy-follow-ups.ts` selects unresolved non-P0 findings and leaves the historical create constant unused, while `ops/hosted-autonomy-follow-up-render.ts` renders v2 and recognizes v1 markers.
